# A window's declared title reached no platform at all.
#
# And a child was added through a switch over C types -- two of them, actually:
# the cgo path knew seven parents and the wrapped path three, so a frame or a
# popover in wrapped mode fell through to raw cgo in a file built without cgo.
# Both now come from the introspection data. The vbox nests so the append is a
# real parent-child one; a top-level widget is parented to __root by BuildUI and
# never reaches the append path at all.

sngl generate --lang go --platform gtk4 --out out app.sngl

grep 'WindowSetTitle\(win, "Counter"\)' out/model.go
grep 'BoxAppend\(m.__n1, m.__n0\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

component main {
    var count int = 0
    window(title="Counter") {
        vbox {
            text(value=string(count))
            button(text="+", @click { count = count + 1 })
        }
    }
}
